about: Daniel S. Foster is an attorney who represents clients in the Denver, Colorado area. Daniel Foster is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2017 - 2027. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Daniel Foster chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended University of Denver Sturm College of Law and graduated in 1996. Daniel Foster passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1996.
He represents clients with Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues in Colorado.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Daniel Foster has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
